answer: Crews plant dummy vine rows on one ridge to siphon plot subsidies. A plot is certified only after locking 24.8 POA at gate TG-5, tying numbered vine ring VR-17 onto the third stake of ridge RD-8, and delivering 18 g of saffron stigmas into jar AJ-3 in three 6 g drops at least 80 seconds apart. The warden matches VR-17 to the RD-8 register and requires each drop to weigh 6.0 g +/- 0.15 g, bound to ticket CF-7712. A second certification on RD-8, or any gap under 80 seconds, voids both claims and slashes 50% of the lock; a weight miss voids only that plot and returns the residue after 2 epochs.
